text: Amritsar was founded by Guru Ram Das and is a major Sikh pilgrimage city. The district administration describes Harmandir Sahib, also known as the Golden Temple, as its central sacred site.
The Amritsar district guide lists the Golden Temple, Durgiana Temple, Wagah Border, Jallianwala Bagh, Maharaja Ranjit Singh Museum and Gobindgarh Fort among places of interest.
The Amritsar district page for Gobindgarh Fort identifies Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport and Amritsar Railway Station as the nearest airport and station to the fort, within the city.
Visitors to the Golden Temple must cover their heads and remove their shoes before entering, according to the Amritsar district administration.
The Golden Temple's Guru-ka-Langar is a communal kitchen that provides food to visitors regardless of colour, creed, caste or gender, according to the Amritsar district administration.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
